deferred.reason: Partial production-readiness review focused on core trust boundaries; exhaustive repository audit remains out of scope for this report.
Dependency advisory/decompression audits and packaged native runtime tests were not performed.

explicitExclusions.reason: Separate generated demonstration, outside core product review focus.
Third-party content corpus not exhaustively audited.

openQuestions.question: Core review is partial: large server.mjs, planners.mjs, database.mjs and most frontend components were selectively inspected; bundled code, binaries and dependencies not exhaustively audited.
No live provider calls, full packaged-app shutdown test, cross-account exploit, dependency advisory audit, clean-Mac install, load/soak or restore drill was performed.

Effective Codex filesystem/network sandbox behavior and read-only confidentiality need separate runtime verification; declared tool classes are instructions rather than separately enforced permissions.
Third-party XLSX parsing/decompression limits need independent implementation and resource-isolation validation.

surfaces.label: Local engine authentication and terminal authority
surfaces.notes: Source validation confirms missing client identity; loopback binding and browser Origin/Host protections reduce remote exposure.

surfaces.label: PTY interpreter startup
surfaces.notes: Python starts in repository cwd without isolated mode; fixed command text does not enforce module provenance.

surfaces.label: Workspace manifest and artifact containment
surfaces.notes: Inert local reproduction confirmed ancestor-symlink external capture. No deployed Codex sandbox escape or real data exfiltration is asserted.

surfaces.label: Provider endpoint and credential boundaries
surfaces.notes: Fixed hosted provider destinations and canonical secret names, redirect rejection, and loopback Ollama checks at provider_connections.mjs:51-185, chat_adapters.mjs:89-107, planners.mjs:77-119. Memory endpoints are explicitly configured and use separate credentials; no independent arbitrary credential forwarding finding established.

surfaces.label: Exact approval, proposal scope and reviewed memory
surfaces.notes: Exact hash and context admission (server.mjs:2725-2788), selected-node proposal checks (chat_routes.mjs:47-98,178-212), and current local memory validation (harness_memory.mjs:76-108; memory_adapters.mjs:42-45). API caller identity remains the separate reported failure.

surfaces.label: Targeted model, terminal and artifact rendering
surfaces.notes: Inspected TerminalPanel.tsx:6-7,72 uses text rendering; no innerHTML/eval sink found in targeted searches; packaged/static script CSPs limit execution. This is not exhaustive frontend coverage.

surfaces.label: Evidence parser limits and process isolation
surfaces.notes: evidence.mjs:10-29,292-312,320-386,416-424 bounds input, YAML aliases, declared ZIP sizes and extraction. XLSX dependency decompression implementation was not audited; malformed declared sizes bypass remains unproven.

surfaces.label: Process lifetime and output bounds
surfaces.notes: Reliability plan covers planner TERM-only deadline (planners.mjs:401-434), absent planner/executor stdin error listeners, and unbounded provider JSON response parsing (planners.mjs:121-145). No exploit or production crash claimed.

surfaces.label: Startup modes, private data and package authority
surfaces.notes: Packaged uses app_data/engine-data/local.db, app_data/engine-data/object-store and HOME workspace root; embedded uses dataDir/state/local.db and workspaces. Rust precreates engine-data without explicit mode; actual ACL/umask privacy needs runtime validation. Packaged skills path is explicit and does not consume EGE_SKILLS_ROOT, unlike direct startup (main.rs:140-181; embedded.mjs:41-60; sidecar.mjs:36-58). Ad-hoc signing and absent native-picker grant are documented release/authority boundaries, not independent proven attacks.
